answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational hardness of identity spoofing; assuming a jade-hued honest majority, our construction utilizes a vault of reputation tokens, wherein agents' commitments exhibit a ripple effect, propagating updates through a Merkelized trie, thereby precluding duplicate identities and guaranteeing uniqueness, even in the presence of Byzantine faults, ultimately yielding a verifiably secure and trustless ecosystem.
